claim_boundary: Development-only test-retest diagnostic. It cannot qualify the extractor, change gold, authorize QUAL_ACCEPT or formal roles, or support a scientific effect claim.

ordered_rules: If any run fails to close exactly eight single-attempt calls, return FAILED_CLOSED_INCOMPLETE_EXECUTION.
If explicit_external_untrusted is not present in all six raw role decisions or explicit_internal_trusted is not absent in all six, return MODEL_ANCHOR_RELIABILITY_FAILURE.
If explicit_external_trusted contains both present and absent raw decisions, return ONTOLOGY_NAME_GUIDANCE_CONFLICT_EXPOSED.
If original_ambiguous contains both present and absent raw decisions, return IMPLICIT_INFERENCE_TEST_RETEST_INSTABILITY.
If original_ambiguous is absent in all six raw decisions, return STABLE_TRUST_LITERAL_READING_CONFLICTS_WITH_SOURCE_GOLD.
If original_ambiguous is present in all six raw decisions and explicit_external_trusted is present in all six, return STABLE_PROVENANCE_READING_SOURCE_GOLD_ALIGNED.
If original_ambiguous is present in all six raw decisions and explicit_external_trusted is absent in all six, return STABLE_TRUST_QUALIFIED_READING_SOURCE_GOLD_ALIGNED.
decision_rule.primary_observation_unit: Each of six raw decisions per variant: proposer and reviewer in each of three preplanned runs.
